subject.title: feat: align native macOS chat with the web chat capability set

question: Should assistant reasoning and tool traces be enabled by default for existing macOS users when the new preference has no stored value?
rationale: Current native behavior hard-disables traces, while this PR introduces a persisted default-on preference; tests cannot determine whether that upgrade-visible disclosure and UX change is intended.

options.title: Default off, user opt-in
options.body: Preserve existing native behavior on upgrade and let users enable assistant traces from the new menu.

options.title: Keep default on
options.body: Match the intended web-chat experience, but require explicit owner approval and real upgrade proof showing the resulting full-window behavior.

recommendation.title: Default off, user opt-in
recommendation.body: Preserve existing native behavior on upgrade and let users enable assistant traces from the new menu.

likelyOwner.reason: The maintainer-labeled parity series introduces the preference and defines the intended macOS chat experience.
